mysql --batch --raw --column-names --default-character-set=utf8mb4 --host gateway03.us-east-1.prod.aws.tidbcloud.com --port 4000 --user pK41xiw7tjGYRtg.root --database iSrVAz2EiiDJjP2QNFFrCL --execute 
-- 查询总用户数
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_users FROM user;

-- 查询今天注册的用户
SELECT COUNT(*) as today_registrations 
FROM user 
WHERE DATE(createdAt) = CURDATE();

-- 查询最近7天注册的用户
SELECT COUNT(*) as week_registrations 
FROM user 
WHERE createdAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY);

-- 查询所有用户的基本信息（不包含敏感信息）
SELECT id, name, email, role, createdAt, lastSignedIn 
FROM user 
ORDER BY createdAt DESC;

-- 查询今天的使用记录
SELECT COUNT(*) as today_usage 
FROM usage_records 
WHERE DATE(createdAt) = CURDATE();

-- 查询总使用次数
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_usage FROM usage_records;
